t: Forge Steel drain coil ideal for clearing stubborn blockages in domestic and commercial drainage systems. The durable drain unblocker features a 5m stainless steel cable, providing excellent reach for sinks, basins, and bath plug holes. A flexible spring navigates pipe bends efficiently, reaching around corners, while the 8mm worm screw end effectively breaks up and clears obstructions. Includes a soft-grip handle to provide comfortable operation for plumbers and serious DIYers. Not suitable for toilets.
